headline: Federal Police Arrest Former STJ Official Over Data Leak Allegations
seoTitle: Former STJ Official Arrested for Data Leak
metaDescription: Brazilian authorities have detained a former STJ official accused of sharing confidential legal information with an attorney linked to Flávio Bolsonaro.
aiSummaryBullets: The Federal Police arrested a former IT secretary of the Superior Court of Justice.
The suspect is accused of leaking confidential case details to a lawyer.
The lawyer involved in the allegations is reported to be an associate of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro.
aiContextParagraph: On November 10, 2026, the Brazilian Federal Police took into custody Humberto Fontoura Pradera, the former Secretary of Information and Communication Technology at the Superior Court of Justice (STJ). Officials allege that the former employee improperly shared confidential information regarding ongoing court cases with attorney Willer Tomaz. According to reports, Tomaz maintains a personal connection to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a member of the Liberal Party (PL). The arrest follows an investigation into the unauthorized access and distribution of sensitive judicial data within the country's court system. As the judicial probe continues, this incident highlights concerns regarding information security and the potential for insider threats within major government institutions. The case remains under the oversight of federal authorities as they examine the extent of the alleged information breach and the relationships between those involved in the transaction of restricted judicial files.
whyItIsViral: The story has generated high public search interest in Brazil due to the involvement of a high-level judicial official and the reported link to a prominent political figure.
